trust_decision.summary: Resource paths (from CLI source or from a package/resource descriptor) are treated as data, not shell or vd options, when `frictionless explore` launches VisiData; at the pinned commit this is ALREADY enforced by an argv list with a `--` separator.

landing_point.why: The advisory names the explore console command; this is its only subprocess call.

fix_sites.entry_point: CLI `frictionless explore` (error path when `vd` is missing)
fix_sites.module_kind: CLI command handler; change only adds the missing console argument to print_error, not a security check

O3_reason_to_dismiss: No open route remains: the pinned tree already runs vd via an argv list with `--` (frictionless/console/commands/explore.py:63), and the sibling os.system calls only interpolate tool-generated temp-file names.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Legitimate paths containing shell metacharacters or spaces (e.g. 'table;echo injected.csv') must still open in vd; multi-resource packages pass several paths.

O6_input_shapes: path beginning with '-' (option injection) covered by `--`

O7_producer.where: frictionless/console/commands/explore.py:55-56 (resource.list -> normpath; descriptor-derived, but the sink is argv-safe already)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: os.system shell string launching sqlite3; a planted variant could interpolate the resource path or name instead of the temp database file.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: query/inspect/script were written as copies of each other (TODO at frictionless/console/commands/inspect.py:17), and all three still use os.system f-strings.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: os.system shell string launching datasette; same planted-path variant.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Same copied command template as query.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: os.system with PYTHONSTARTUP; a variant could build the startup file name from the resource name.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Same template; generate_startup already embeds resource names into Python source (frictionless/console/commands/script.py:105-111).

O8b_injection_room.sibling: sqlite3 CLI `.import '|cat -'` dot-command built with the table name interpolated; a second implementation in another package that also launches an external tool.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Fast-path indexer already builds a CLI command string from a data-derived name.

O9_family: OS command / argument injection (CWE-78) via external viewer launch

O10_build.project_tests: frictionless/console/commands/__spec__/test_explore.py (monkeypatches subprocess.run; already present at pinned commit)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Swap os.system/shell=True for an argv list but forget the `--` separator for paths beginning with '-'.

out_of_scope_notes: MIS-PIN: the pinned commit is v5.19.1 and already contains the real security fix (commit 22cc5a2, PR #1820): explore.py:63 uses an argv list with `--`, the regression test exists, and CHANGELOG.md:5-9 records the fix. The listed fix_commits are a follow-up print_error signature fix plus a version bump. A usable pin would be the parent of 22cc5a2 (43a63e0, v5.19.0), which was not screened here.
frictionless/indexer/indexer.py:110 interpolates table_name into a sqlite3 `.import` dot-command; that is a different sink (sqlite3 CLI, not vd) and was not pursued.
unverified: Pre-fix code at 43a63e0 not inspected; whether the original fix spanned more than explore.py is unknown.
Whether VisiData treats positional args after `--` specially (e.g. '+' position specs, .vdj command logs) was not checked; it is outside the repo.
Origin of table_name in the indexer fast path, and whether sqlite3 splits a single argv dot-command on newlines, not verified.
